|errata_history=Versions of [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. Found while comparing the Committee's 2008 re-issue of the sheet with the January 2007 sheet (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visibly different printing is a version).
* '''Original''' ([[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V) (Virtual Set 12)]]): the release sheet “Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates” (Players Committee, “Official text as of January 9, 2007”; PDF dated 10 January 2007; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007), page 5, slip 38 ([[:File:OVS12-38-Mara_Jade_The_Emperor_s_Hand-slip-2007-01-09.png]]), in the Committee's Remaster template; game text as above. Deploy 6, forfeit 7. Credit line, printed sideways in the side margins: “Original concept by Justin Roth” / “New York State 2005”.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the re-issued sheet (PDF dated 12 August 2008; headed “Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 20 February 2009), page 5, slip 38 ([[:File:OVS12-38-Mara_Jade_The_Emperor_s_Hand-slip-2008-08-12.png]]). '''What changed''' (errata to card #38 of 21 March 2008): the slip now covers the whole card and is placed over •Mara Jade With Lightsaber — its top half prints that card's title, icons, destiny 1 and lore; deploy is 5 (was 6), forfeit 7; the game text is unchanged (re-set: “she” moved up to the first line); the credit line “Original concept by Justin Roth / New York State 2005” is no longer printed. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
|printings='''Decipher (Reflections II foil)''' — [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (Reflections II Foil)|Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (foil)]]<br />'''Virtual Original''' — [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] (<code>110_10</code>)<br />'''Virtual Original''' — [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V) (Virtual Set 12)]] (<code>1112_38o</code>)<br />'''Virtual Original Errata''' — '''this page''' (<code>1112_38</code>)<br />'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] (<code>226_8o</code>)<br />'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V) (Errata)]] (<code>226_8</code>)
